{{Short description|Russian mathematician (born 1966)}}
[[File:Orlov DO.jpg|thumb|Image of Orlov ]]
''' Dmitri Olegovich Orlov''', (Дмитрий Олегович Орлов, born September 19, 1966, in [[Vladimir, Russia]]) is a Russian mathematician, specializing in algebraic geometry. He is known for the Bondal-Orlov reconstruction theorem (2001).<ref>{{cite web|title=Bondal-Orlov reconstruction theorem|website=nLab (ncatlab.org)|url=https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Bondal-Orlov+reconstruction+theorem}}</ref>

==Education and career==
In 1988 Orlov graduated from the Faculty of Mechanics and Mathematics of [[ Moscow State University]]. There he received his [[Candidate of Sciences]] degree (PhD) 1991 with thesis Производные категории когерентных пучков, моноидальные преобразования и многообразия Фано (Derived categories of coherent sheaves, monoidal transformations and Fano varieties) under [[Vasilii Alekseevich Iskovskikh]] (and Alexey Igorevich Bondal).<ref>{{MathGenealogyProject|id=95470}}</ref>
At the [[Steklov Institute of Mathematics]], Orlov was from April 1996 to April 2011 a researcher in the Algebra Department and is since April 2011 the head of the Algebraic Geometry Department.<ref>{{cite web|title=Dmitri Orlov|website=ResearchGate|url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Dmitri-Orlov}}</ref> In 2002 Orlov received his [[Doctor of Sciences]] degree (habilitation) with thesis Производные категории когерентных пучков и эквивалентности между ними (Derived categories of coherent sheaves and equivalences between them).<ref name=isaran>{{cite web|url=http://isaran.ru/?guid=B3F8F926-22B9-F427-43BE-F145ADF04CC9&q=ru/person|title=Орлов Дмитрий Олегович (ИС АРАН)|publisher=isaran.ru}}</ref> In 2002 he was, with A. Bondal, an Invited Speaker with talk ''Derived categories of coherent sheaves'' at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Beijing.<ref>{{cite book|author=Bondal, A.|author2=Orlov, D.|chapter=Derived Categories of Coherent Sheaves|title= Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians|year= 2002|volume= 2|pages= 47–56|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150326152902/http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM2002.2/Main/icm2002.2.0047.0056.ocr.pdf |archive-date=2015-03-26 |chapter-url=http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM2002.2/Main/icm2002.2.0047.0056.ocr.pdf}}</ref>

Orlov's research deals with [[homological algebra]], ([[Derived category|derived categories]], [[Triangulated category|triangulated categories]]), [[algebraic geometry]] ([[derived algebraic geometry]], [[homological mirror symmetry]], quasicoherent [[Sheaf (mathematics)|sheaves]], and [[noncommutative geometry]].<ref>{{cite web|title= Orlov, Dmitri Olegovich, Member of the Russian Academy of Sciences|website=mathnet.ru|url=http://www.mathnet.ru/eng/person11896}}</ref>

{{blockquote|Orlov is one of the pioneers of the modern emerging categorical framework which unites the commutative and noncommutative algebraic geometry, via the study of enhanced triangulated categories of quasicoherent sheaves.<ref>{{cite web|title=Dmitri Orlov|website=nLab (ncatlab.org)|url=https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Dmitri+Orlov}}</ref>}}

He was elected on December 20, 2011, a corresponding member and on 15 November 2019 a full member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Орлов Д.О. - Общая информация |url=https://www.ras.ru/win/db/show_per.asp?P=.id-46871.ln-ru.dl-.pr-inf.uk-12 |website=www.ras.ru |access-date=8 June 2024}}</ref>
